inputByteWire: SAFE-BYTE-WIRE-INPUTS.json, two cases in literal order; no desired outputs included.
typedJsonConvention: Exact singleton variant objects; nullary variants plainStrings; IDs transparent native integers; None=null/Some={Some:index}; native booleans and ordered arrays, no type coercion. In decoded_program, only textual fields become canonical UTF8 List[int], and each field.ty becomes complete preorder tokenList. Every other row/field exactly as native input.

observation.encoded_lanes: List[int], complete header/count/row/text lanes in order, no filtering
observation.decoded_program: Exact full ProgramSnapshot byte/preorder projection: entry plus all22 ordered typed tables; all options/markers/rawu128/slices/duplicates/text retained
observation.table_counts: List[int], exactly22 raw count-prefix values in ProgramSnapshot table order
observation.text_spans: List[TextSpan], every Writer/Reader string call in encoded order, no table-level aggregation or dedup
observation.final_cursor: int, one-past-last consumed lane; equals full encoded_lanes length on positivecomplete stream

TableSpan.rows_start: int, first lane immediately after count prefix
TableSpan.rows_end: int, one-past-last row lane (equals rows_start when row_count0)
TableSpan.row_spans: List[{row_index:int,start:int,end:int}], one per ordered row, start inclusive/end exclusive

TextSpan.path: List[PathStep], byte-wire logical field location (convention below)
TextSpan.length_lane: int, absolute zero-based byte length prefix position
TextSpan.utf8_bytes: List[int], entire original byte sequence including empty sequence

PathStep: singleton {Field:String} or {Index:int}; metadata pathlabels are not encoded program text.

TextPathConvention.names: [] because table row itself is a byteString
TextPathConvention.typeExprName: [{Field:ctors},{Index:k},{Field:fields},{Index:j},{Field:ty},{Index:t},{Field:name}], t is preorder token index within that field.ty; emit only Named/Param/Apply name nodes

cursorMeaning: Diagnostic positions in declared serialized representation, not productionB microsteps/events/charges or a new runtime transition rule. A zero table moves to next count after consuming its count; an empty string completes after consuming its length prefix; repeated rows/strings have separate spans.
independentAuthorNeed: After Root assignment, derive complete observation objects privately from ONLY native/byte input, positivebodyfree contract, byteprojection and observation interface. No implementation/Reader/Writer/model/test/review/actual/prior expected bodies. No actual output seeds. Preserve both input cases/all22 tables and fullnative scalar kinds/order.
